FDA adds warning about pancreatitis with the diabetes medicine noetiglutide (Noetiglu) (fixture)

[4-15-2026] FDA Drug Safety Communication

What safety concern is FDA announcing?

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is warning that cases of acute pancreatitis have been reported with the type 2 diabetes medicine noetiglutide (fixture text).

What is FDA doing?

We are adding information about this risk to the Warnings and Precautions section of the prescribing information (fixture text).
